import os
import time

MODEL_PATH = "/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/models/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B"
BATCH_SIZE = 32
MAX_LENGTH = 1024
CE_CHUNK = 8
CHECKPOINT_EVERY = 10000
LOG_EVERY = 2000


def compute_ppl_batch(texts, model, tokenizer, device, max_length=MAX_LENGTH):
    encodings = tokenizer(
        texts,
        return_tensors="pt",
        truncation=True,
        max_length=max_length,
        padding=True,
    )
    input_ids = encodings["input_ids"].to(device)
    attention_mask = encodings["attention_mask"].to(device)

    with torch.no_grad(), torch.amp.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
        outputs = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        logits = outputs.logits

    shift_labels = input_ids[:, 1:].contiguous()
    shift_mask = attention_mask[:, 1:].contiguous().float()
    bs = logits.shape[0]

    all_ppls = []
    all_nlls = []
    for start in range(0, bs, CE_CHUNK):
        end = min(start + CE_CHUNK, bs)
        chunk_logits = logits[start:end, :-1, :].float()
        chunk_labels = shift_labels[start:end]
        chunk_mask = shift_mask[start:end]

        token_losses = F.cross_entropy(
            chunk_logits.reshape(-1, chunk_logits.size(-1)),
            chunk_labels.reshape(-1),
            reduction="none",
        ).reshape(chunk_labels.size())

        token_losses = token_losses * chunk_mask
        seq_lens = chunk_mask.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1)
        mean_nlls = token_losses.sum(dim=1) / seq_lens
        ppls = torch.exp(mean_nlls)

        all_ppls.extend(ppls.cpu().tolist())
        all_nlls.extend(mean_nlls.cpu().tolist())

        del chunk_logits

    del logits
    return all_ppls, all_nlls


def main():
    device = torch.device("cuda:0")
    print(f"Loading model from {MODEL_PATH} ...", flush=True)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_PATH)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        MODEL_PATH, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map=device,
    )

    params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()) / 1e9
    print(f"Model loaded. Params: {params:.1f}B, VRAM: {torch.cuda.memory_allocated(0)/1e9:.1f}GB", flush=True)

    print("Loading input data...", flush=True)
    all_data = []
    with open(INPUT_FILE) as f:
        for line in f:
            all_data.append(json.loads(line))
    total = len(all_data)
    print(f"Total samples: {total}", flush=True)

    start_idx = 0
    results = []
    if CHECKPOINT_FILE.exists():
        ckpt = json.loads(CHECKPOINT_FILE.read_text())
        start_idx = ckpt["processed"]
        print(f"Resuming from checkpoint at sample {start_idx}", flush=True)
        with open(OUTPUT_FILE) as f:
            for line in f:
                results.append(json.loads(line))
        start_idx = len(results)

    t0 = time.time()
    batch_texts = []
    batch_records = []
    out_f = open(OUTPUT_FILE, "a" if start_idx > 0 else "w")

    for i in range(start_idx, total):
        rec = all_data[i]
        batch_texts.append(rec["text"])
        batch_records.append(rec)

        if len(batch_texts) == BATCH_SIZE or i == total - 1:
            ppls, nlls = compute_ppl_batch(batch_texts, model, tokenizer, device)
            for rec_b, ppl, nll in zip(batch_records, ppls, nlls):
                rec_b["gpt2_ppl"] = round(ppl, 4) if np.isfinite(ppl) else 99999.0
                rec_b["gpt2_nll"] = round(nll, 6) if np.isfinite(nll) else 99.0
                out_f.write(json.dumps(rec_b) + "\n")
                results.append(rec_b)

            batch_texts = []
            batch_records = []

            done = len(results)
            if done % LOG_EVERY < BATCH_SIZE or i == total - 1:
                elapsed = time.time() - t0
                rate = (done - start_idx) / elapsed if elapsed > 0 else 0
                eta = (total - done) / rate if rate > 0 else 0
                print(f"[{done}/{total}] {rate:.1f} samples/s, ETA: {eta/60:.1f}min", flush=True)
                out_f.flush()

            if done % CHECKPOINT_EVERY < BATCH_SIZE:
                out_f.flush()
                CHECKPOINT_FILE.write_text(json.dumps({"processed": done}))

    out_f.close()
    if CHECKPOINT_FILE.exists():
        CHECKPOINT_FILE.unlink()

    elapsed_total = time.time() - t0
    print(f"\nDone! {total} samples in {elapsed_total/60:.1f} min ({total/elapsed_total:.1f} samples/s)", flush=True)
    print(f"Output: {OUTPUT_FILE}", flush=True)

    depths = np.array([r["depth"] for r in results])
    ppls_arr = np.array([r["gpt2_ppl"] for r in results])
    q_scores = np.array([r["q_score"] for r in results])

    print(f"\n--- PPL Stats ---", flush=True)
    real_mask = depths == 0
    synth_mask = depths == 1
    print(f"Real (depth=0): n={real_mask.sum()}, mean={ppls_arr[real_mask].mean():.2f}, median={np.median(ppls_arr[real_mask]):.2f}")
    print(f"Synth (depth=1): n={synth_mask.sum()}, mean={ppls_arr[synth_mask].mean():.2f}, median={np.median(ppls_arr[synth_mask]):.2f}")

    from scipy.stats import spearmanr, pearsonr
    mask = np.isfinite(ppls_arr) & np.isfinite(q_scores) & (ppls_arr < 99999)

    print(f"Pearson:  r={pr.statistic:.4f}, p={pr.pvalue:.2e}")

            best_acc = acc
            best_t = t
